about: The core's licence audit (floor rule 10): what its own workflows and scripts use, held to the tools' list by scripts/licences.mjs with .github/licences.json, which the core's tests workflow runs. Nothing of the core ships. A project's scan leaves its copy of the core out, since this audit holds it; its own uses of the same actions are in its own audit. The scan's own script and test are left out of the scan, since they name the forms it looks for.

entries.name: actions/setup-node
entries.used: the workflows that run a script, on the core's one Node

entries.name: actions/download-artifact
entries.used: preview.yml, the site a pull request's build uploaded

entries.name: actions/dependency-review-action
entries.used: licences.yml, the licence gate on new and updated packages

entries.name: GitHub's commit signing key
entries.used: personal-terms.yml fetches GitHub's public key (https://github.com/web-flow.gpg) to check that a merge was signed by GitHub, which floor rule 11's exception asks: a GitHub service, nothing of which ships

entries.name: CodeQL CLI
entries.used: code scanning, run by github/codeql-action: a GitHub service, free while a repository is public

entries.name: GitHub CLI
entries.used: gh in versions.yml, core-moved.yml (through scripts/core-moved.mjs), delete-merged-branches.yml and preview.yml, the runner's own

entries.name: jq
entries.used: versions.yml, the runner's own: it reads the issues the versions check would open; and scripts/core-moved-test.mjs, which runs through it the expression gh is handed

entries.name: spdx-expression-parse
entries.used: scripts/readers-test.mjs, in the core's own tests only: SPDX's own expression parser, the reference the licence check's expression readers are held to, fetched by npm pack (which runs nothing it fetches), checked by its sha512 and run only there

entries.name: spdx-license-ids
entries.used: scripts/readers-test.mjs, in the core's own tests only: SPDX's list of licence ids, which spdx-expression-parse reads, fetched by npm pack (which runs nothing it fetches), checked by its sha512 and run only there

entries.name: spdx-exceptions
entries.used: scripts/readers-test.mjs, in the core's own tests only: SPDX's list of exceptions, which spdx-expression-parse reads, fetched by npm pack (which runs nothing it fetches), checked by its sha512 and run only there

entries.name: @xmldom/xmldom
entries.used: scripts/readers-test.mjs, in the core's own tests only: an XML parser, the reference the NuGet check's manifest reader is held to, fetched by npm pack (which runs nothing it fetches), checked by its sha512 and run only there

entries.name: Node.js
entries.used: every script: the core's one exact Node, .node-version, which scripts/node.sh fetches as the node-linux-x64 or node-linux-arm64 package (npm pack) and checks by its sum

entries.name: npm
entries.used: bundled with Node: npm view in versions.mjs, npm pack in node.sh, npm ci and npm audit signatures in signatures.yml
